title: Marrakech's Water Future: 140km Desalination Pipeline from Safi Breaks Ground
body:
Morocco's Ministry of Equipment and Water confirmed groundbreaking for the Safi-Marrakech water pipeline before end of 2026, with desalinated water expected to reach Marrakech by 2028. The project addresses the city's long-term water stress caused by declining Tensift river flows.

Project Details

The Safi desalination station will produce 200,000 cubic metres of potable water daily. A 140km pipeline will carry water inland. The total project cost is 4.2 billion MAD financed by the Moroccan state, Hassan II Fund, and African Development Bank.

Source: Kech24, Morocco Ministry of Equipment and Water.
